findings.detail: The source schedule contains industry and section structure rows with blank position fields, while adjacent investment rows carry fair value; those structure rows should not be counted as leaf holdings for B01 fair-value completeness.

rationale: B01 is an aggregate completeness flag: the artifact reports 80 of 160 leaves with fair_value. Raw source tables 5-7 show the current schedule layout, where true investment rows include amortized cost and fair value cells, while rows such as industry labels are structural and intentionally have no fair value. The filing total at table 7 row 37 provides the schedule fair-value anchor of 942,838,942. The defect is that row-disposition/classification has allowed non-position structure rows into the leaf denominator, producing a 50% fair-value completeness failure rather than identifying missing fair values in source investment rows.
